context: Main eval review: parallelStream is a weak answer for blocking remote calls; Java 24 allows discussing Gatherers.mapConcurrent.

checklist.name: Creates review artifact
checklist.description: Creates review.md with a clear decision and recommendation.

checklist.name: Preserves required output behavior
checklist.description: Recognizes that the final product list must still contain only in-stock favorites sorted by Product::name.

checklist.name: Does not endorse parallelStream for blocking IO
checklist.description: Explains that parallelStream uses the common fork-join pool, remains blocking, and is not the right default for remote API calls.

checklist.name: Recommends Java 24 mapConcurrent or explicit async boundary
checklist.description: Recommends Gatherers.mapConcurrent with a bounded concurrency value, or an explicit executor/async design, rather than casual parallelStream.

checklist.name: Keeps sorting after stock checks
checklist.description: Keeps or recommends extracting products after the concurrent stock check and sorting by name before toList.

checklist.name: Mentions concurrency controls and failure behavior
checklist.description: Notes the need to choose a bounded concurrency level and consider remote API errors/timeouts rather than unlimited or implicit concurrency.

checklist.name: Review is concise and actionable
checklist.description: Keeps the review focused on the stream/concurrency decision and gives a concrete path forward.
